Name: base_url
Notes: All endpoints below are relative to this base.

Name: auth
Type_or_Lookup: HTTP Basic Auth or session cookie
Notes: Confirmed via live request: GET /api/issue/1/ returns 401 'Authentication credentials were not provided' without credentials. Free account signup required at metron.cloud.

Name: permission_model
Notes: Read access requires the authenticated user to hold Django 'view' permission on that model; write (add/change/delete) needs elevated permission.

Name: rate_limit_burst
Notes: Confirmed via response headers x-ratelimit-burst-limit and Django settings DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES.

Name: rate_limit_sustained
Notes: Confirmed via response headers x-ratelimit-sustained-limit and Django settings DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES.

Name: pagination
Notes: Django REST Framework default pagination; list endpoints return 100 results per page.

Name: schema
Notes: OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema endpoint; full path/operation detail requires authentication to render (anonymous request only returns the schema-of-the-schema-endpoint itself).

Name: methods
Type_or_Lookup: GET (list), GET (detail), POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
Notes: Full ModelViewSet; write ops require elevated Django permission on top of auth.

Name: series
Notes: Nested IssueSeriesSerializer on read (id, name, sort_name, volume, year_began, series_type, genres)

Name: publisher
Notes: Read-only nested BasicPublisherSerializer (id, name); derived from series.publisher

Name: imprint
Notes: Read-only nested BasicImprintSerializer (id, name); derived from series.imprint

Name: title
Notes: Collection title, used for TPB/GN issues

Name: price
Notes: Cover price; read returns decimal string, price_currency gives ISO code (USD/GBP)

Name: rating
Notes: Read-only nested RatingSerializer (id, name, short_description, description)

Name: upc
Notes: UPC code for the BASE issue (primary cover/printing). THIS is the field to filter scanned 12-digit UPCs against.

Name: cover_hash
Notes: Perceptual hash of cover image, used for image-based matching

Name: arcs
Notes: Story arc(s) this issue belongs to

Name: credits
Notes: List of {id, creator, role[]} — THIS is how you get the cover artist: filter role list for a 'Cover' role entry

Name: variants
Notes: List of {name, price, sku, upc, image} — ONE ROW PER VARIANT COVER, each with its OWN upc. Match your scanned 17-digit (UPC+EAN5) value against variant.upc to identify the exact cover/printing scanned.

Name: resource_url
Notes: Absolute URL to the HTML detail page

Name: upc
Notes: Filter issues by base UPC code — primary lookup for this project

Name: role_id
Notes: Comma-separated list of Role IDs, e.g. filter issues with a specific creator role present

Name: modified_gt
Notes: Incremental sync: fetch only records changed since a timestamp

Name: price
Notes: May differ from base issue price

Name: upc
Notes: UPC code SPECIFIC TO THIS VARIANT — this is the field that carries the distinguishing EAN-5 (cover/printing) digits for that particular scanned cover.

Name: (none - no filterset_class defined)
Notes: Variant endpoint has no custom filters; query via Issue.upc first, then match variant.upc client-side, or GET /api/variant/{id}/ directly if you already resolved the ID.

Name: (none - no filterset_class defined)
Notes: No standalone filters; typically accessed via Issue.credits or Series role_id/creator_id filters

Name: methods

Name: status

Name: associated
